original.statement: For environments where Flux was installed using the bootstrap procedure, upgrading the Flux controllers to this release is an operator step: generate the new Kubernetes manifests with the Flux CLI and push them to the Git repository where bootstrap was run (including any extra components enabled at bootstrap), or rerun the bootstrap command for each cluster using the same arguments as before.

decision.reason: [ev-b1e8ad65539c] is the general Flux upgrade guide. It explains how bootstrapped controllers can be upgraded, either by generating manifests and pushing them to Git or by rerunning bootstrap. It does not say that anything was added, changed or made mandatory in 2.7.0. Nothing in it ties a required migration step to this release, so calling it a "migration-required" change overstates mandatory work, and no correct typed assertion follows from this how-to text.
